title: A Study of PARG Inhibitor FORX-428 in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors.
official: A Phase 1 Study of PARG Inhibitor FORX-428 in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors With BRCA1/2 Mutations or Other DDR Deficiencies or High Replication Stress.
summary: The goal of this interventional study is to evaluate the safety and tolerability of escalating doses of FORX-428 as monotherapy in patients with select advanced solid tumors with BRCA1/2 mutations or other DDR deficiencies or high replication stress, and to determine the maximum tolerated dose (MTD) and Recommended Cohort Expansion Dose (RCED) of FORX-428 as monotherapy.

sites.f: University of Texas - MD Anderson Cancer Center
